title: Fix duplicate-row bug in WNBA ETL merge() pattern
description: Five WNBA ETLs use db.merge(Obj(...)) without setting the primary key id, which always INSERTs rather than upserts. Affected: update_team_roster, update_team_offense_stats, update_team_defense_stats, update_injury_status, today_active_players. Tables with unique constraints (offense/defense_stats, injury_status, today_active_players) now hard-fail on second run; team_roster silently duplicates rows. Discovered during Phase 2 T14 smoke 2026-05-22. Convert all five to INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE (Postgres native upsert) and add a UNIQUE(team_id, player_id) constraint to pred_wnba_team_roster. Manual dedupe SQL applied to recover team_roster on 2026-05-22.
close_reason: Converted five WNBA ETLs to Postgres ON CONFLICT upserts; added UNIQUE(team_id, player_id) on pred_wnba_team_roster
